title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.75
exact_target: Do two incomparable prime sets always generate a proper subgroup of the class-transposition group permitted by their union?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2584 (KOU-21.75). CC BY 4.0.

S. Kohl, Problem 21.75, in E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), \emph{The Kourovka Notebook: Unsolved Problems in Group Theory}, 21st edition, arXiv:1401.0300v48 (6 October 2026). See also source definitions in Problems 17.57 and17.60. This version records equality instead of the proposed strict containment; the displayed question is the historically registered target.
